properties.title: Tuvalu: 37.3% connectivity drop (bgp)
properties.summary: Tuvalu (TV): 37.3% connectivity drop (BGP -37.3%) over 1 h 5 min, against the same hours of the 7 days before. active probing left out: its baseline median, 7.0, is under the floor of 20. OONI has 0 measurements from Tuvalu in the 2 hours from 00:00 UTC (about 0 on a usual day at those hours), too few to read blocking; late uploads can still add some. The drop alone doesn't tell a shutdown (BO-H-1A) from a power or physical fault (BO-H-1B). Other measurers in this country within 24 h: Cloudflare Radar 0 outages and 0 verified anomalies; NetBlocks 0 posts. Access Now's STOP sheet lists no shutdown in this country in 2025; context only, not evidence about this outage.
